name: Voxelize Point Cloud (Advanced Mode)
definition: A voxelization mode that accepts a cell length parameter. If the cell length is zero, the spacing becomes zero, causing all points to be skipped due to infinite/NaN coordinate mapping.
summary: Voxelize Point Cloud (Advanced Mode) maps 3D points to a grid using a cell length parameter, uniquely allowing zero spacing which causes silent failure by skipping all points.
